tools.name: timestamp_fingerprint
tools.description: Create a private, dated proof that a file or data existed, without sending the data. Use this when you already have the SHA-256 fingerprint (hash) of a file; for a short text, use timestamp_text instead. Compute the hash locally over the exact bytes (for example: sha256sum MyFile.pdf) and pass the 6

tools.name: timestamp_text
tools.description: Compute the SHA-256 fingerprint of a short text on the Proof-100 server (the text is not stored), then write that fingerprint privately on the BitcoinZ blockchain. Returns the fingerprint, the transaction ID and a viewing key for this one proof. Keep the viewing key: with the txid it reveals this pr

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Show how many Proof-100 proofs are left and the BTCZ deposit address for buying more.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "timestamp_fingerprint" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
